items.source: Note that using @Primary at the class level has no effect unless component-scanning is being used. If a @Primary-annotated class is declared via XML, @Primary annotation metadata is ignored, and <bean primary="true|false"/> is respected instead.
items.translation: 注意，除非使用组件扫描，否则在类级别使用 `@Primary` 不会产生任何效果。如果通过 XML 声明了带有 `@Primary` 注解的类，则会忽略 `@Primary` 注解元数据，而尊重 `<bean primary="true|false"/>`。

items.source: May be used on any class directly or indirectly annotated with @Component or on methods annotated with @Bean.
items.translation: 可用于直接或间接标注了 `@Component` 的任何类，或用于标注了 `@Bean` 的方法。

items.source: This annotation is semantically equivalent to the <bean> element's primary attribute in Spring XML.
items.translation: 此注解在语义上等同于 Spring XML 中 `<bean>` 元素的`primary` 属性。

items.source: Because HibernateFooRepository is marked with @Primary, it will be injected preferentially over the jdbc-based variant assuming both are present as beans within the same Spring application context, which is often the case when component-scanning is applied liberally.
items.translation: 由于 `HibernateFooRepository` 被标记为 `@Primary，如果两者都作为 Bean 存在于同一个 Spring 应用程序上下文中（在广泛应用组件扫描时经常会出现这种情况），它将优先于基于 JDBC 的变体被注入。

items.source:
Primary beans only have an effect when finding multiple candidates
for single injection points. All type-matching beans are included when
autowiring arrays, collections, maps, or ObjectProvider streams.
items.translation: 主 Bean 仅在为单一注入点查找多个候选者时才生效。在自动装配数组、集合、Map 或 ObjectProvider 流时，会包含所有类型匹配的 Bean。
